# Vendored Hallow bundles

`overlay.js` and `vite-plugin.js` are prebuilt from Hallow commit `309c13d926ff6e10c65f0c3191f48af4095f4547`.

The overlay bundle includes its `html-to-image` dependency and keeps React external. Its required MIT notice is preserved in [`LICENSE-html-to-image`](./LICENSE-html-to-image). The Vite plugin keeps its public `@babel/core` dependency external.
